idea-plugin.name: SOUP List Lint
idea-plugin.description:
Reads your SOUP register the way an auditor does: 16 rules over clauses 8.1.2, 5.3.3, 5.3.4, 4.3 and 7.1.3.

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → SOUP List Lint: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. Offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/soup-list-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/soup-list-lint

action.text: SOUP List Lint: Check This File
action.description: Run SOUP List Lint on the file in the editor
